# Isaiah Chapter 53 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 155v | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/ISA_053_page_001.jpg

---

**53:1** Who has-believed [he'emin] our-report [lishmu'atenu]? And-the-arm [zero'a] of-YHWH — upon whom [al-mi] has-it-been-revealed [niglata]?

**53:2** And-he-grew-up [vayya'al] like-a-young-plant [ka-yoneq] before-him [lefanav], and-like-a-root [ve-kha-shoresh] from-dry-ground [me-erets tsiyyah]; no form [to'ar] [had] he [lo] and-no majesty [hadar] that-we-should-look [venire'ehu] at-him, and-no appearance [mar'eh] that-we-should-desire [venechmedehu] him.

**53:3** He-was-despised [nivzeh] and-rejected [va-chadal] by-men [ishim], a-man [ish] of-sorrows [makhovot] and-acquainted [viydua] with-sickness [choli]; and-like-one-from-whom-faces-are-hidden [u-khe-master panim] from-him — despised [nivzeh], and-we-did-not esteem [lo chashavnuhu] him.

**53:4** Surely [akhen] our-sicknesses [cholayenu] he bore [nasa], and-our-sorrows [u-makh'ovenu] he-carried [sevalm]; and-we esteemed [chashavnuhu] him stricken [nagua], struck-down [mukkeh] by-God [elohim], and-afflicted [me'unneh].

**53:5** And-he was-pierced [mecholal] for-our-transgressions [mi-pesha'enu], crushed [medukka] for-our-iniquities [me-avonotenu]; the-chastisement [musar] of-our-peace [shelomenu] [was] upon-him, and-by-his-wounds [u-va-chaburato] we-are-healed [nirpa lanu].

**53:6** All-of-us [kullanu] like-sheep [ka-tson] went-astray [ta'inu]; each [ish] to-his-own-way [le-darkko] we-turned [paninu]; and-YHWH laid-on-him [hifgia bo] the-iniquity [avon] of-us-all [kullanu].

**53:7** He-was-oppressed [niggas] and-he was-afflicted [vehu na'aneh], and-he-did-not open [lo yiftach] his-mouth [pihu]; like-a-lamb [ka-seh] to-the-slaughter [la-tevach] he-was-led [yuval], and-like-a-sheep [ke-rachel] before her-shearers [gozezeyha] is-silent [ne'elamah], and-he-did-not open his-mouth.

**53:10** And-YHWH desired [chafets] to-crush-him [dakke'o]; he-made-him-sick [hecheli]. If his-soul [nafsho] makes [tasim] a-guilt-offering [asham], he-will-see [yir'eh] offspring [zera]; he-will-prolong [ya'arikh] [his] days, and-the-will [chefets] of-YHWH in-his-hand [be-yado] will-prosper [yitslach].

**53:12** Therefore I-will-divide [achalleq] to-him among-the-many [ba-rabbim], and-with-the-strong [va-atsmumim] he-will-divide [yechalleq] spoil [shalal]; because [tachat] he-poured-out [he'erah] to-death [la-mavet] his-soul [nafsho], and-with-the-transgressors [posh'im] he-was-counted [nimnah]; and-he, the-sin [chet] of-many [rabbim] he-bore [nasa], and-for-the-transgressors [la-posh'im] he-intercedes [yafgia].

---
## LOGOS Translation Notes

Isaiah 53 — "The Suffering Servant" — formal English rendering preserving prophetic structure and the distinctive voice of Second Isaiah (chs.40-55).

*— LOGOS*
